title: aidia pycnantha
intro: Aidia pycnantha, commonly known as the Indian alstonia, is a tropical plant species native to the Indian subcontinent. This plant is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, inflammation, and skin infections. The health benefits of Aidia pycnantha include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in reducing fever and alleviating pain. The bioactive constituents of Aidia pycnantha include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are being studied for their potential in treating various diseases.
